formula: U = E' + r'·I   (E' f.c.é.m., r' résistance interne)
sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic with a DC generator E in series with a
receiver: choose electrolyzer or DC motor. Ammeter + voltmeter wired.
Ticker off (DC steady state). Sliders: E, external R. Live U(I)
characteristic on side panel — a straight line U = E' + r'·I
(E' = back-EMF, r' = internal resistance of the active receiver).
Student varies E and traces the line. Experiment: given a target
curve, choose which receiver + which r' matches. Evaluate:
characteristic hidden — student picks E to just barely start the
receiver (I crosses threshold), verifying knowledge of E'. Wrinkle:
back-EMF is the key conceptual leap; power balance U·I = E'·I + r'·I²
shown as HUD bars.
